message.comment: Match ends, Real Madrid 3, Barcelona 1.
Second Half ends, Real Madrid 3, Barcelona 1.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Barcelona 1. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) left footed shot to the bottom right corner after a fast break. Assisted by Jude Bellingham.
Pedri (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Barcelona 1. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) header from the centre of the box. Assisted by Lamine Yamal with a cross.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Rodrygo replaces Vinicius Junior.
Attempt saved. Raphinha (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box is saved in the bottom left corner.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Barcelona 0. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box. Assisted by Kylian Mbappe.
Corner, Barcelona. Conceded by Antonio Rudiger.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 1, Barcelona 0.
First Half ends, Real Madrid 1, Barcelona 0.
Attempt missed. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) right footed shot from the right side of the box is close, but misses to the right.
Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a tactical foul.
Attempt blocked. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box is blocked.
Corner, Real Madrid. Conceded by Jules Kounde.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, Barcelona 0. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the far corner. Assisted by Kylian Mbappe with a through ball.
Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) hits the crossbar with a header from the centre of the box.
Attempt missed. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box is high and wide to the right.
First Half begins.
Lineups are announced and players are warming up.
